item.title: Meduza: ‘You could call it running away’: For some Russian emigrants, leaving the country was just the beginning. Now they live their lives on the road.
item.description: Most Russians living abroad try to return to a familiar way of life as quickly as possible: they rent an apartment or a house, work or look for stable jobs, and spend most of their time in a single country. But some emigrants live differently. They move constantly from place to place, turning their everyday lives into one long journey. Meduza spoke with three emigrants who left Russia and chose a life on the road.
